verdict.rationale: Mintlify's docs say it gives each pull request a unique preview URL so reviewers can see changes in a live environment before merging to production. The editor review flow lets users share previews with the team, and the REST API can create or redeploy previews per branch. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of automatic per-PR previews, and detail on how shareable preview links are (access controls, external sharing).

support.subject: As a developer, every docs pull request gets a shareable preview deployment before it merges

citations.quote: Get unique preview URLs for each pull request so reviewers can see documentation changes in a live environment before merging to production.
Preview changes before they go live, share them with your team, and approve and merge pull requests from the editor.
Create or update a preview deployment for a specific branch. If a preview already exists for the branch, it triggers a redeployment.
